none: PAS NLM-1C5594: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Roxby cum Risby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 321-323, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust, possibly helmeted, cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]O[--]-NOBC[--]. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed VO / TIS / XX. Reverse inscription: probably [BEATATRAN QVILLITAS]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 2.32gms, die…
